servinfo.title: ISG Drive Belt Inspection

item.ptxt: Check ISG drive belt when engine is cool.

It is not possible to check the ISG drive belt length by observing the alignment of the slit (2) on auto tensioner (1) and “
” mark (3) on timing chain cover.
If the ISG drive belt used for the inspection is a new one, or if the check result is not OK, replace the auto tensioner.

servinfo.ptxt: Check the following points. If check result is not OK, replace ISG drive belt (4).

item.ptxt: Check ISG drive belt for crack, tear, deformation, wear or dirt.
When engine is idling or racing, check that there is noise from ISG drive belt.
